999008199.text: さあ皆の衆、採取もあと一息ですわ！

localizations.en: Alright everyone, we're almost done gathering materials!

999008199.text:
ですが、ささいな気の緩みが命取りになります。
周囲の警戒を怠らず、気を引き締めてまいりましょう

localizations.en:
However, even a moment's carelessness could prove fatal.
Let's stay vigilant and keep our guards up.

999008199.text: はい、ララ様！　ララ・キングダムに栄光あれ！！

localizations.en: Yes, Queen Lara! Glory to the Kingdom of Lara!!

999008199.text: ミーケ頑張るから、いっぱいよしよししてね！

localizations.en: I'll give it my all, so I'd be overjoyed if you could reward me with lots of head pats!

999008199.text: さすがは王だな。先導も板に付いている

localizations.en: You're starting to carry yourself like a true monarch.

999008199.text: ふふ。今さら、認めていただいても遅いですわね

localizations.en: Hehe. It's a bit late to be acknowledging me now, isn't it?

999008199.text: その王に背いたこと、忘れてはおりませんわよ

localizations.en: I haven't forgotten how you once defied your queen.

999008199.text:
ふむ。その件に関しては、王の許しを
得たと思っていたのだが……

localizations.en:
Hmm. I was under the impression I'd already been
forgiven for that particular transgression...

999008199.text:
では、友好の証であるこの衣装は、
今ここで脱ぐべきだろうか？

localizations.en:
Should I remove these clothes then,
the symbol of our friendship?

999008199.text:
それには及びませんわ。
あなたはララ・キングダムの栄えある賓客ですもの

localizations.en:
That won't be necessary.
You are, after all, an honored guest of the Kingdom of Lara.

999008199.text: それは光栄だな

王に背いた件については、つい口に出ただけですわ。
気にしていませんから、絶対

localizations.en:
That bit about defying me just slipped out.
I'm absolutely not bothered by it anymore.

999008199.text:
あの二人、過去にわだかまりがあったようですが、
すでに和解できたようですね

localizations.en:
Those two seem to have had some friction in the past,
but it looks like they've made peace.

999008199.text:
うん。マリオンさんから注意するように聞いてたけど、
あの様子なら大丈夫そうだね

localizations.en:
Yeah. Marion warned us to keep an eye on them,
but they seem to be getting along fine!

999008199.text: 良いものですね、友好の証というのは

localizations.en: It's wonderful what a token of friendship can do.

999008199.text:
えっ！
今、ララ・キングダムに移住したいって言った？

localizations.en:
What?!
Did you just say you wanted to move to the Kingdom of Lara?

999008199.text: ついに二人も、ララ様に忠誠を誓う気になったようね

localizations.en: It seems these two are finally ready to pledge their loyalty to our queen.

999008199.text:
何をどう聞けば、そうなるのですか？
一言も言っていません

localizations.en:
How did you arrive at that conclusion?
We didn't say anything of the sort.

999008199.text:
むう。ララ様の徳を浴びている今なら
いけると思ったのにねぇ～！

localizations.en:
Aww. I thought we could convince you
while you're basking in our queen's glory~!

999008199.text: でも、せっかくだから一度遊びに行ってみたいなあ

localizations.en: Though I wouldn't mind visiting, since we're here and all.

999008199.text: ええ、ぜひ。きっと気に入ると思うわ

localizations.en: Oh yes, please do! I'm sure you'll love it.

999008199.text:
そしてずっとそこに住みたくな～る、
住みたくな～る。今ならララ様ペンダントが特典だ～

localizations.en:
And then you'll want to stay forever and ever~
Plus we're giving out Queen Lara pendants right now~

999008199.text: そ、それはどうかなあ……

localizations.en: I-I'm not so sure about that...
